QuestInfo.name: Delivering the Lunch Box
QuestInfo.0: #bMom#k seems to have something she wants you to do. Talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Mom asked you to deliver the #t4032448# to #bDad#k, who is working at the #b#m100030300##k. Go to the #m100030300#. Leave the house and head #bto your left#k.

1.0: Oh, Evan! What are you doing here? Are you here to help your old man? Hey, that's a Lunch Box you've got there!

yes.0: Ah, I knew I was missing something! I always am, it seems. Today it was my #t4032448#, yesterday it was my hat, and the day before it was my shoes. I'm getting so forgetful!
yes.1: In any case, since you're here, will you do me a favor?

npc.0: Have you gone to see your father yet? He's working at the #b#m100030300##k. You can get there by leaving the house and #bheading left#k.

item.0: Oh, Evan! What are you doing here? Are you here to help your old man? For some reason, I'm so hungry that I just don't have the energy to work.

lost.0: You lost the Lunch Box? Your clumsiness comes from your father's side of the family. Here, I packed a fresh #b#t4032448##k. Take it to to your father at the #b#m100030300##k.
